name: truckwithease
description:
TRUCKWITHEASE is the premier all-in-one commercial motor carrier operations platform and in-cab driver command center. Built by truckers for CDL drivers, owner-operators, and fleet managers nationwide.

KEY FEATURES:

• FMCSA COMPLIANT ELD & HOS:
49 CFR § 395 compliant Hours of Service e-logs with live 11-hour driving, 14-hour shift, 30-minute break, and 70-hour cycle clocks. Instant 1-click eRODS transfer to state troopers and DOT safety inspectors.

• LOW-BRIDGE CLEARANCE RADAR:
Item 54B bridge height alerts prevent devastating overhead bridge strikes with real-time route clearance mapping.

• 80,000 LB COMMERCIAL LOAD SHEETS & AXLE SCALES:
Automated steer, drive, and tandem axle weight distribution calculations to prevent overweight bridge formula violations.

• AUTONOMOUS PRE-TRIP & POST-TRIP DVIR:
Complete vehicle defect logs under 49 CFR § 396.11 with mechanic sign-offs, memory recall, and roadside audit dossiers.

• 50-STATE TOLLS & DRIVEWYZE BYPASS:
Integrated weigh station bypass directory, toll pass guide, and route cost calculators.

• IN-CAB FLEET TELECOM & HOTLINE:
Dedicated in-cab VoIP lines, dispatch messaging, and 24/7 compliance support hotline.

• AUTOMATED IFTA FUEL TAX AUDITS:
Automatic state-by-state GPS odometer mileage tracking and quarterly fuel receipt calculation.

• THE "KNOW IT ALL" MASTER MECHANIC:
Instant SPN/PGN heavy-duty fault code diagnostics, torque specifications, and roadside recovery assistance.

Drive smart. Protect your CDL. Stay 100% compliant with TRUCKWITHEASE.
